title: Keeping the Ball Rolling: Fullerene-like Molecular Clusters
claim: The review's fullerene-like classification is topological and should not be extended automatically to every large, spherical, or multishell metal cluster.
explanation: The authors focus on cores with twelve pentagonal rings and explicitly exclude some of the discussed lanthanide–nickel multishell structures from that subgroup.
scope: Classification of the clusters discussed in this Account.
caveats: Fullerene-like topology alone does not establish common bonding, formation mechanisms, or physical properties across the three core-composition families.
evidence_locations: Section 1, paragraphs defining scope and groups
Section 3.2, paragraph following the 108- and 136-metal examples
